query: Please implement a database modification history recording tool to track changes made to the database. The tool should have functionalities for recording changes, viewing history records, and comparing different versions. Users should be able to log in, record database modifications, view history records, compare different versions of changes, and export modification reports. Configure your theme with medium spring green as background and green as component color.
